done.why: I had seen a handful of places and picked up a few things. I couldn't tell what to do next, and I had cut myself off from the ledge, so I stopped.

about: An underground dungeon world. You arrive at the bottom of a stair after a dream about a final test. You explore passages, a sunlit cliff, a sea and a ledge. Something unseen, perhaps a person, watches and plays with you from above.

ending.what: None reached. I left holding a lantern, bread and a vial.

moments.note: Walking south in the dark gave a grue warning straight away.
Pulling the sword got a joke reply: 'Who do you think you are? Arthur?'
On the ledge, something unseen above twitched the rope and laughed at me.
'Call out hello' was not understood. The shout command just gave 'Aaaarrrrgggghhhh!'
Saying hello to the sailor made him give me a gift, the vial.
The rope wouldn't climb up and I couldn't tell what to do about the watcher.

wished: Talk to the unseen watcher above the cliff.
Know how to open the locked chest.
Have a clearer sense of what the final test was.

lines.line: Far above you, at the brink of the cliff, something that is not a tree moves against the light, and the rope twitches once
lines.why: It made the world feel inhabited.

lines.line: I have waited three ages for someone to say those words
lines.why: Plain 'hello' was the right move, and it paid off.

fun.why: Small discoveries and humour, but little direction.

engagement.why: The watcher hooked me, but I stopped early.

difficulty.why: Mostly gentle, though the goal wasn't clear and the scramble down was a one-way move.

interestingness.why: Varied places and a mysterious presence.

prose.why: Vivid scene descriptions and playful responses.
